label: Indoor combustion sources
definition: Incense (bakhour and oud) burning gas stoves in attached kitchens and household tobacco smoke
citation: Yeatts 2012 (10.1289/ehp.1104090): 86 % of the UAE source population exposed to incense weekly and 44 % daily, incense frequency associated with rising PM2.5 and PM10 quartiles (p 0.020 and 0.0009), NO2 twice as likely with a gas stove in an attached kitchen. Amoatey 2018 (10.1016/j.envint.2018.09.043) lists Arabian incense with infiltration as a main GCC indoor source.

label: Indoor-generated classroom particles
definition: Resuspended dust chalk and occupant activity particles inside classrooms independent of outdoor infiltration
citation: Faria 2020 (10.1016/j.buildenv.2020.106666): classroom PM2.5 35.3 ug/m3 more than double homes with I/O 1.8 from indoor sources and resuspension. Rivas 2014 (10.1016/j.envint.2014.04.009): school PM2.5 1.7 times urban background from organic fibres chalk and playground sand. Arar 2021 (10.3390/ijerph182212091): UAE nursery TSP driven by children's physical activity.

label: Peak exposure events
definition: Short high-concentration episodes during transport and cooking counted separately from daily means
citation: Dons 2019 (10.1016/J.ATMOSENV.2019.06.035): 2.8 peaks per person per day, 5.5 % of time gave 21.0 % of exposure, daily mean only moderately correlated with peak frequency (r 0.44). Jeong 2018 (10.1016/j.scitotenv.2018.04.399): peaks above the time-weighted average were 60 % of daily black carbon exposure.

label: Migrant outdoor labour exposure
definition: Exposure of labour-camp construction and service workers who spend long outdoor hours
citation: Al Hurini 2024 (10.7759/cureus.74951): 83.4 % of 397 Ajman labour camp workers outdoors in heat more than two hours a day, longer for South Asian and single workers. Existing X07 does not carry the migrant and camp-housing dimension.
